summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings filed a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing a non-binding term sheet to acquire a 50.01% controlling interest in a Polish data-center development company expected to hold 66.67% of two project companies (Warsaw ~130 MW, Wroclaw up to 140 MW; combined up to 270 MW). No price, premium, or closing date was stated. Polish partners retain 33.33%; CFO Eli Yoresh holds 10% of the target, a related-party conflict. Term sheet is non-binding; grid permits expected by end-2027. Watch dilution, financing, and related-party approval risk.
